data.name: Jayesh Manani

experiences.description: Developed AI use‑case solutions leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for information retrieval. Evaluated and implemented generative AI/LLM solutions with cross‑functional security teams. Built an LLM‑based RAG chatbot for product data management using Llama 3.1, Azure Databricks and vector retrieval. Designed data ingestion and retrieval pipelines with Python, embedding models and Databricks for structured and unstructured enterprise data. Created scalable cloud data pipelines on Azure Databricks, Azure Storage and Delta Lake. Implemented experiment tracking and evaluation workflows with MLflow for RAG performance. Developed Python components, REST API integrations and automated CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD and Jenkins to improve reliability.

Worked on AI use‑case development, generative AI and ML engineering, enterprise generative AI solutions, AI knowledge retrieval and data processing, cloud data engineering, LLM evaluation and MLOps, and software engineering automation. Delivered production‑ready backend services, REST APIs and CI/CD pipelines, and contributed to generative AI research initiatives.

Implemented and evaluated multi‑agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms with PhD researchers for complex simulation environments. Developed high‑performance simulations using JAX and JaxMARL on GPUs and translated research papers into reproducible Python implementations for benchmarking.

Developed data analytics workflows, a Flask‑based billing automation application, and lightweight backend services to improve operational efficiency and reporting. Integrated Power BI for enterprise analytics dashboards.

Built a cloud‑based fund management platform using Python, REST APIs, AWS and GCP with security and compliance requirements. Automated post‑trade processing, fund allocation and compliance workflows, reducing manual effort by 60‑70%.
